description: List the price proposals the commerce pipeline drafted, newest first, each with its status (proposed, approved, rejected, executed, failed or expired), the current and proposed price and the policy that produced it. Filter by status. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce catalog read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Defaults to 100.

name: list_commerce_proposals
